summary: New Horizon Aircraft Ltd. filed an 8-K regarding a registered direct offering of 5,385,646 Class A ordinary shares and pre-funded warrants for 4,574,514 shares at $2.51 per share, raising ~$25.0M in gross proceeds. The pre-funded warrants have a $0.001 exercise price and expire when fully exercised. Net proceeds will fund the Cavorite X7 prototype completion and testing. Closing is expected on May 27, 2026. A 45-day lock-up restricts further equity issuance. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation.
